_about: Per-achievement tier points for the addon's offline total-AP calculation. Keyed by achievement id under `ach`: {t:[[count,points],...], r:repeatable(0/1), c:point_cap}. Daily/Weekly/Monthly achievements are excluded (their AP is the account's capped daily_ap/monthly_ap). The runtime sums tier points vs /v2/account/achievements progress and adds daily_ap+monthly_ap. `build` is the GW2 build id this was generated against (build_achievement_points.py --check skips the rebuild when the live build matches). Regenerate with builder/build_achievement_points.py.
